episode_summary: In this episode, Chris Linsell discusses the potential future of Zillow as a major brokerage, the impact of the 21st Century Road to Housing Act on inventory, and the evolving role of AI in real estate. He emphasizes the importance of agents providing unique, lifestyle-focused insights that AI cannot replicate, and explores the potential rise of indie brokerages in a changing market landscape.
